title.zh: 将北伊罗戈省马科斯市镇阿拉班小学的名称变更为Fortunato Daquioag纪念小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Alabaan Elementary School in the Municipality of Marcos Province of Ilocos Norte, to Fortunato Daquioag Memorial Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Alabaan Elementary School in the Municipality of Marcos Province of Ilocos Norte, to Fortunato Daquioag Memorial Elementary School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5619_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Alabaan Elementary School in the Municipality of Marcos, Province of Ilocos Norte, is hereby changed to Fortunato Daquiaog Memorial Elementary School.

This Act shall effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
